name: campus-nest
description: CampusNest — Smart Student Housing & Co-Living Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
